description: This file defines the internal class DirectoryMembershipSnapshot, which manages and provides information about the current membership of silos in an Orleans cluster, including ring ranges and partition mappings.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of the directory membership in an Orleans cluster, including ring boundaries, member ranges, and partition mappings.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshot.RangeCollection
classes.description: A read-only collection of ring ranges and associated member and partition indices within a DirectoryMembershipSnapshot.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshot.RangeCollection.RangeCollectionEnumerator
classes.description: Enumerator for iterating over the range collection in DirectoryMembershipSnapshot.

methods.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshot
methods.description: Constructor initializing the snapshot based on cluster membership and grain factory.

methods.name: GetRange
methods.description: Returns the ring range for a given silo address and partition index.

methods.name: GetMemberRanges
methods.description: Returns the ring ranges associated with a specific silo address.

methods.name: GetMemberRangesByPartition
methods.description: Returns the ring ranges for a specific silo address, partitioned.

methods.name: TryGetOwner
methods.description: Attempts to find the owner silo and partition for a given grain ID or hash code.
